title: AI and the next move for engineers

beats.copy:
A judgment from my years at Amazon. / Organizational capacity
Jobs it can afford / Business need
Value it must create / A company’s ability to fund roles is different from the need it serves.
beats.fallback: Native type preserves the claim and source boundary.

beats.copy:
Where does the work
become useful? / A career question, made more pressing by stronger execution tools.
beats.fallback: Native type preserves the claim and source boundary.

beats.copy: An organization can create its own work. / More layers / More coordination / More internal work / Customer needs may grow much more slowly.
beats.fallback: Native type preserves the claim and source boundary.

beats.copy: Hard work can be absorbed internally. / That shaped how I read the later restructuring.
beats.fallback: Native type preserves the claim and source boundary.

beats.copy: 2024 / Reduce layers. / Fewer layers / Fewer unnecessary processes / Amazon’s stated organizational priorities.
beats.fallback: Native type preserves the claim and source boundary.

beats.copy: 2025 / An AI workforce forecast. / Andy Jassy expected a smaller total corporate workforce over time.
beats.fallback: Native type preserves the claim and source boundary.

beats.copy:
2026 / Restructuring continued. / Public statement
Fewer layers, less bureaucracy / Interpretation boundary
No verdict on a person / An announcement cannot establish an individual’s contribution.
beats.fallback: Native type preserves the claim and source boundary.

beats.copy: Cheaper execution changes the calculation. / My interpretation: it accelerates organizational reassessment.
beats.fallback: Native type preserves the claim and source boundary.

Invest in the work
around the code. / Customers. Product choices. Work that reaches use.
